results.title: Tar Heels Reclaim Victory Bell in Second‑Half Surge Over Duke
results.description: The University of North Carolina's football team fought back from a 17‑point deficit to win 24-20 against the Duke Blue Devils, restoring the Victory Bell rivalry trophy after dropping it earlier in the year. The game featured a dramatic defensive collapse by Duke and a resilient offense run by senior quarterback Billy Edwards Jr., as well as notable defensive insights from former NFL coach Bill Belichick who was in attendance. The match showcased UNC's ability to adjust while dealing with injuries to key player Benjamin Hall and exploited Duke's run‑heavy offense led by Nate Sheppard. The victory places UNC back into the spotlight for the remainder of the season.

results.title: Michigan Benches Bryce Underwood at Halftime and Beats Penn State
results.description: Michigan had 80 yards and no points at halftime when Kyle Whittingham replaced Bryce Underwood with freshman Tommy Carr. The Wolverines scored all 21 of their points after the break to beat Penn State 21-18, and Whittingham would not say who starts against Indiana.
